name: bottomsheet
need: Show a short task or details from the bottom edge on a phone, with heights to rest at and a drag to dismiss

--ds-bottomsheet-width.description: bottom sheet: the panel at most, centred on a wider screen

--ds-bottomsheet-gap.description: bottom sheet: the room above the panel at its full height

--ds-bottomsheet-radius.description: bottom sheet: the panel's top corners at the default shape

labExempt.DS.bottomsheet.create: events only: the detents and the drag are shown in the entry bottomsheet-open

ripple..ds-bottomsheet__handle: a drag handle: the panel follows the finger from it, which is the press; a ripple would stay behind while the panel moves
